headline: ARENA ARCHERY seats two — and stops fizzling
lede: The two-player duel now ships with receipts: seat two is driven, proven and human-grade, arrows fired without a direction aim where you face, and the phone keeps one clean pad.

notes.text: #2558 shipped (354c2f7): archeryplay grew a DUEL section — 40 checks in which real WASD+F keystrokes walk, jump, charge, hit, pull and WIN from seat two, both players' shafts stamped the same tick with P1 first, and the whole two-human stream replays hash-identical.

The browser drive caught a live bug the pure sim never showed: release the draw with no direction keys held and the arrow spawned at your feet with zero velocity — a dud that pulled itself back. A direction-free release now looses toward your facing, TowerFall-style; the autopilot streams are byte-identical, so every witness still hashes.

Phone law honoured: the on-screen second touchpad is retired (AGENTS.md: two players is the desktop keyboard option). One pad against the autopilot on the phone; 2 at the marquee seats the couch duel.
Polish pass filed for QA (#2565): kill juice, flush-stick angles, duel ceremony, fletching, seat-keyed release sound.

look.text: Duel a friend at one keyboard — press 2 at ARENA ARCHERY
